assets.name: 01-graphite-roots-floor
assets.label: 연필 숲 · 뿌리 암반
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE square 2D side-view terrain sprite, final deliverable 256x256 pixels, for Unfin, a serious atmospheric metroidvania set inside an abandoned sketchbook. This is a single tile asset, not a tilesheet, not a room scene, not a cube or freestanding prop.
Art quality: sophisticated high-resolution dark fantasy game illustration; atmospheric terrain richness associated with Ori, Hollow Knight and Dead Cells, WITHOUT pixel art. Smooth antialiasing. Detailed crafted materials and powerful readable forms, NOT cute mobile-game boulders or simplistic vector blobs. Intricate secondary detail is clustered, with large restful shadow planes. Dense art-directed material work, NOT a photorealistic PBR scan, NOT a low-poly render. Original art, no characters or copied motifs.
The square is completely occupied by solid material in orthographic SIDE VIEW. Only the named exposed edge has a dark continuous gameplay contour with finely worn rim. The other three borders crop straight through material with NO outline, NO bevel, NO border shadow, NO frame, NO rounded canvas corners. Quiet matching graphite-toned material at joining edges; no empty background, no transparent margins, no checkerboard, no text. Exposed-edge relief stays within the tile. Neutral diffuse material lighting, subtle occlusion in cracks, no baked spotlight, glow, fog, vignette or external cast shadow. Rich texture must survive reduction to256px; varied large structural forms, medium erosion and selective fine cracks. Low-to-medium values, restrained saturation, never featureless black. Do not make all five materials generic shale: this tile's material identity must be immediately apparent.
MATERIAL: ANCIENT GRAPHITE ROOT STRATUM. Dense petrified woody roots are compressed into a dark graphite bed, intricate interwoven angular root ribs, bark lamination, fine capillary root impressions, thin polished graphite seams and chipped mineral pockets. Mostly graphite greys #25272C #41454F #5E6168 with sparse cool ash edges. No green leaves or bright moss. Make the large twisted root forms clearly recognizable rather than anonymous rock shards. EXPOSED EDGE: TOP, level walkable edge exactly at top canvas boundary. A tightly interlocked compacted root-and-stone cap occupies upper12percent; slightly chipped only inward. Left/right cap profiles at same height and thickness, bottom is continuous solid material. Large diagonal root and two smaller winding roots through central interior, irregular spacing. Mature eerie buried forest feeling.
assets.editPrompt: Use case: lighting-weather. EDIT the provided terrain tile, preserving its material identity, composition, edge geometry, original detailed texture at its exposed edge, orientation and square crop. User asks for the earth beneath the ground surface to be so dark it is almost invisible. Apply this to this tile's interior: fade downward from the TOP surface into near-black charcoal #090B10. Keep a thin detailed visible material band only within the first 8 percent depth from that exposed surface. From 8 to 24 percent depth, texture visibility falls off smoothly and quickly following individual relief shapes. Beyond 25 percent depth, the entire remaining three quarters of the solid tile is nearly uniformly black #090B10 with only the faintest 1-2 percent residual tonal detail; no visible large veins or highlights there. THIS MUST BE A STRONG DARKENING, not subtle. Almost all interior detail should disappear. Preserve the natural rich worn surface texture in the thin edge band. No glow, bloom, white outline, fog, spotlight, bright bottom or side rim, text, framing or new objects. This is deliberately an opaque dark terrain silhouette with just a readable edge. Do not turn it into a separate floating rock. Keep transparent areas transparent if any; any existing empty backdrop outside the exposed edge should be deep neutral #10151D. No pixel art. Produce one edited tile only.
